subject.title: test(ui): cover text-only tool result rendering

question: Should OpenClaw accept Chat Completions payload-content diagnostics under `OPENCLAW_DEBUG_MODEL_PAYLOAD=full-redacted`, despite prompt and tool-result text remaining log-visible after redaction and capping?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands a sensitive diagnostic path; whether its forensic value outweighs the operational logging exposure is a product and security-boundary choice, not a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Keep tests, drop content diagnostics
options.body: Retain only the regression coverage and remove the Chat Completions full-payload diagnostic expansion.

options.title: Accept the diagnostic boundary
options.body: Keep the diagnostic after maintainer approval, with explicit operator guidance and a current-head real capture demonstrating the intended redaction and use case.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Defer the diagnostic until a reviewable design can prove useful capture without retaining sensitive payload text in logs.

recommendation.title: Keep tests, drop content diagnostics
recommendation.body: Retain only the regression coverage and remove the Chat Completions full-payload diagnostic expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged related fix and the diagnostic proposal, so they are best positioned to supply the technical tradeoff and evidence for maintainer review.
